rows.note: Seam with S02387 (slice 08, object clause ending in wo): S02387 should read as a full statement, e.g. 'It was clear fighting in space would intensify again.' If S02387 already says 'Foreseeing/Anticipating...', change this row to 'the AEUG'.

rows.en: Having covered the shuttle launches in this battle,
preparing for the battles to come,
Struck by a laser beam a full 6 km wide,
all its key officers fell in battle,
rows.note: Shared with 0e05 (after S02459). 'its' = the Titans, named in the line before in both intros.

rows.en: But the AEUG, too, paid a heavy price,

rows.note: Shared with 0e05 (after S02461); 'and' joins both preceding lines.

rows.en: had all been killed or wounded.
he was wounded and withdrew from the front,
and was forced to spend time recovering.
At this point, having left the front early
and kept its forces intact, Axis
truly reaped the spoils of the others' war.
rows.note: Idiom gyofu no ri (third party profits from two others fighting).

rows.en: No one able to halt Haman's invasion
In the final battle at Core 3,
and Axis, having lost its leader, collapsed.
With all its enemies in the Earth Sphere gone, the AEUG
effectively merged into the Earth Federation Forces
and disbanded as a step forward.
rows.note: hatten-teki kaisan = dissolution as a constructive move, not a defeat.

rows.en: once again entered a time of peace, but
Kamuna had a feeling that someday
he would throw himself into battle again -
he felt it in his bones.
Someone who had vanished a year before -
rows.note: JP inverts: '(he felt it), picturing one person who went missing a year ago...'. Kept as a trailing fragment across 2425-2426; the person's gender is not stated, kept neutral.

rows.en: that one person was on his mind...
the defeated remnants of the Delaz Fleet
went their ways: some fled to Axis,
rows.note: 'went their ways' added only to frame the 'some... others...' pair; can be cut to 'some fled to Axis,'.

rows.en: and others surrendered to the Federation Forces.
Jamitov Hymen and other senior Federation officials
turned the incident to their own advantage.
The turmoil in Hong Kong City

rows.note: itami-wake: a draw where both sides were hurt.

rows.en: To mop up the forces on Earth
and mobile suits into battle one after another.

rows.note: JP 'met resistance from the aces' turned active; result clause follows.

rows.en: and the Titans' gains fell short of their hopes.
three new leaders - at its center,
would shift its battlefield to space.
Kamuna Tachibana, gravely wounded in battle,
rows.note: Shared with 0f05 line 16 (followed by S02488, a 'forced into recovery' predicate); wording works for both.

rows.en: and Tachibana's unit, left without its leader,
could only watch the war unfold from then on.

rows.note: Shared with 0f05 line 4, where it follows S02476 (ends in a comma) and precedes S02477. There a lowercase 'the' is needed; one string cannot serve both. Capital kept for 0e05 (sentence start).

rows.en: The AEUG, for its part, also paid a heavy price,

rows.note: Full-width English subtitle converted to ASCII.

rows.en: it hugely boosted the Zeon remnants' morale.
rows.note: JP relative clause (remnants who hid and resisted for 7 years) recast so each row keeps its own content; meaning unchanged.

decisions: Narration in past tense throughout; JP historical present (houkai suru, yaku) rendered as past.
'the AEUG' with article mid-sentence; glossary forms used for all names.
Shared rows (0c05/0e05/0f05) worded to read correctly in every intro that uses them, except S02457 (see uncertain).
uncertain: S02455: 'tachibana-tai' not in glossary; wrote 'Tachibana's unit' to parallel the glossary 'Kamuna's unit'.
S02457: shared with 0f05 line 4, which follows a comma (S02476); capital 'The' is wrong there. Needs S02476 reworded to end a sentence, or a split row.
S02388: seam with S02387 (slice 08) not yet translated; chose 'Foreseeing this, the AEUG', which assumes S02387 is a full statement.
S02425-26: inverted fragment rendered as 'Someone who had vanished a year before - / that one person was on his mind...'; gender kept neutral.
S02429: added 'went their ways:' as a frame for 'some... others...'; optional.
S02397 vs S02458: 'the Titans fleet' (attributive) vs 'the Titans' main fleet' (possessive); harmonise if a corpus style exists.
